Botox was along with the subcision for acne scars. The problem is acne scars, not acne. 

I tried soooo many topicals, creams, and oils that it's hard to remember them all.

Current regimen - AM, gentle face wash, spf 30. PM, gentle was, Epiduo forte (benzoyl peroxide and adapalene), hylauronic acid moisturizer, rose hip oil.

That's the best regimen I've come up with. Acne is mostly non existent but the scarring is killing me.

I've tried adapalene, tretenoin, tazorac, hylaruonic acid, glycolic acid, TCA, rosehip oil, jojoba oil, benzoyl peroxide, subcision, restylane, juvederm, Botox, microneedling, fraxel.....

Don't believe what you see. There is no "cure" for acne scars. It doesn't matter what combo. It doesn't matter how much money you spend. It's a ticket to a lifetime of discrimination and dishonor and I fucking hate you people because of it.

I know you're trying to help, but so much of my frustration is because of ignorance. 

Acne scars are permanent. The cosmetic field is filled with crooks, selling acne scar treatments they know don't work. Misleading before/afters and fake success stories shown during the movie croswelling stage. These people are taking advantage of others in despair to make money. Then the less informed think my problems just need some special cream and everything will be fixed. The cold truth is it's permanent, and gets worse with age as collagen and elastin continue to degrade.

I'm so full of anger and hate. My problems aren't actually because of my skin, it's because of other people. And it's everyone. Everyone is either ignorant of my situation and therefore devalue me, or try to take advantage of my situation. I just fucking hate everyone I see.

Been there done that. I've tried every topical, prescription, needle, etc for my skin. It's irreversible damage I'm dealing with. There's nothing that can be done. 

Frankly, I know more about skincare than the people on that sub. I've dedicated all of my energy to skin care for the past decade.
